version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-corporate-exact-gleif
protocol: generic
name: Exact corporate entity status from the Global LEI Index
description: Keyless normalization of GLEIF entity status for one exact company and
  registration jurisdiction. Missing, ambiguous, stale and failed queries return non-success
  HTTP status with no active field. No national good-standing or incorporation-date
  claim.
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-hashprice.margyn.workers.dev/truth/v1
auth:
  type: none
cache_ttl_sec: 0
rate_limit_per_sec: 1
endpoints:
- path: /company
  external_path: /company
  method: GET
  description: Read the exact legal name, bare LEI or registry identifier in the requested
    jurisdiction. Preserve company verbatim including punctuation. Registry IDs may
    be numeric or explicitly RA000000:identifier. Supply jurisdiction as ISO country/subdivision
    code or a supported country alias. No brand or fuzzy lookup.
  intents:
  - CORPORATE_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: company
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Exact legal name, LEI or registry identifier, at most 256 UTF-8
          bytes.
      - name: jurisdiction
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Country or subdivision of registration, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - CORPORATE_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_GENERAL
  signal_mapping:
    label_field: active
intent_mapping:
  CORPORATE_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /company
    input:
      company:
        from: company
        how: Preserve the exact company name or identifier verbatim.
      jurisdiction:
        from: jurisdiction
        how: Preserve the registration jurisdiction.
    output:
      active:
        path: active
        how: Copy the Boolean verbatim.
      legal_name:
        path: legal_name
      registration_id:
        path: registration_id
      jurisdiction:
        path: jurisdiction
      registered_address:
        path: registered_address
errors:
  message_path: error.message
  code_path: error.code
